_doc: Runes (src/state/runes.ts) replaced the skill tree's unlock enhancements. Every wave boss carries one rune (rolled at spawn from `runes`, tier from the wave: 1 + floor((wave-1)/wavesPerTier), +climaxBonus for the realm climax, capped at the top tier) and drops it into the Rune Vault when slain. Each target (Citadel, Establishments, Generals, Minions) has slotsPerTarget slots; a rune only fits its own target. A slotted rune adds perTier × tierPower[tier-1] to its stat (summed with the skill tree, capped by the stat's cap). Three runes of the same kind and tier merge into one of the next tier. Runes are kept through Regression.

desc.en: Less damage taken by the citadel
Citadel heals after each cleared wave
desc.tl: Gumagaling ang kuta pagkatapos ng bawat alon
HP ng force field ng establisimyento
Mas maikling pahinga ng kasanayan ng Heneral

desc.en: While their General lives, minions deal more and take less damage
desc.tl: Habang buhay ang Heneral, mas malakas at mas matibay ang mga alagad nito
Samsam mula sa ekspedisyon sa mundo ng tao

desc.en: Cheaper minion summons by their General (100% = free)
desc.tl: Mas murang pagtawag ng Heneral sa alagad (100% = libre)

howTo.en: Every wave boss carries a rune and drops it when slain. Slot runes to empower the citadel, establishments, Generals and minions. Merge {count} identical runes into the next tier. Runes are kept through Regression.
howTo.tl: May dalang runa ang bawat boss ng alon at nahuhulog ito kapag napatay. Ilagay ang runa para palakasin ang kuta, mga establisimyento, Heneral at alagad. Pagsamahin ang {count} magkaparehong runa para sa susunod na antas. Nananatili ang mga runa sa Regression.

noRunes.en: No runes yet — defeat a wave boss to earn one.
noRunes.tl: Wala pang runa — talunin ang boss ng alon para makakuha.
